title: Administration Assistant & Social media
company: Prime Space Midlands Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Administrative Assistant with Social Media & Advertising

Company:

Prime Space Midlands Ltd

Number of openings: 1

Job type: Part time

Hours per week: 15-20

Schedule: Office Based Mon-Fri

Base Pay: From 12.71 / hr

Benefits:

On-site parking

Mileage allowance

Casual Dress

Flexible working where possible

Oportunity to take ownership of projects and grow your responsibilities

We expect this role to occupy 15 hours per week initially; however, this may increase to 20 hours per week over the course of 12-18 months. We can offer some flexibility around the exact working pattern / days for the right person.

Job Description:

Prime Space Midlands Ltd is a growing commercial property management business with a small, hands-on team. We are looking for someone who wants to become genuinely involved in the business rather than simply complete a set list of administrative tasks. The successful candidate will work closely with the director and have the opportunity to take ownership of areas of responsibility as the company grows.

Here is an interesting part-time opportunity where you will work closely with other team members, have genuine responsibility, work across different areas of a growing business and have the opportunity to develop your role.

This is a varied and hands-on role suited to someone who is highly organised, intrinsically motivated, commercially minded, social media savvy and capable of handling multiple projects within a specified timeframe. You will have the responsibilities of managing our social media presence, research and investigation into materials when we are undertaking a development project, assisting other members of the team in all tasks asked of you and maintaining stock levels of consumables.

Key Responsibilities

Implement, manage and continually improve our social media presence

Keep internal management systems updated

Manage appointments and diaries

Contribute to our evolving advertising strategy

Digitizing and keeping up to date existing management systems

Subscription management and consolidation

Liaise with team members on projects and tenant enquiries/queries

Assist the team with administrative work

Managing stock levels of consumables

Research and purchasing

No two days will be the same, and this role is suitable for someone who enjoys variety and wants more responsibility than a traditional administrative position.

Skills

Essential
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Good written and verbal communication
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Able to work independently and manage competing priorities
- Experience with Social Media management
- A practical, proactive approach to problem solving
- Full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle

Desirable
- Previous administrative experience
- Experience using spreadsheets/data-entry systems
- Experience in property, business administration or a similar environment

title: Marketing Executive
company: Work Lyf Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Executive

Work Lyf Group are recruiting for a Marketing Executive on behalf of our client based in Stoke-on-Trent. This is an exciting opportunity for an energetic, creative and outgoing marketing professional to join a growing logistics and supply chain business.

This is a highly visible, front-facing role focused on communications, social media, email marketing, content creation and events. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening the company's brand presence and supporting business growth.

Salary

30,000 - 36,000 per annum

Location

Stoke-on-Trent

Job Type

Permanent, Full-Time

The Role

As Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for creating engaging content, managing social media channels, supporting PR and events and delivering effective marketing campaigns. This role offers genuine opportunities for development within a growing business.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, create and deliver email marketing campaigns to existing and prospective customers.
- Manage and grow social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn.
- Produce engaging internal communications and company updates.
- Develop customer case studies and marketing content to support business development activities.
- Organise and coordinate events, exhibitions and networking opportunities.
- Support directors and senior stakeholders with their personal LinkedIn presence.
- Create marketing materials, graphics and content using platforms such as Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Utilise AI tools to assist with content creation, campaign planning and reporting.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular marketing reports.
- Ensure all marketing communications remain consistent with brand guidelines.

The Ideal Candidate

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience within a marketing, communications or social media role.
- Strong knowledge of LinkedIn and social media marketing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience creating engaging content across multiple channels.
- Confident, outgoing and customer-facing personality.
- Well organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
- Comfortable working closely with senior management and directors.

Desirable Skills
- Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Knowledge of HTML email design.
- Experience using AI tools within marketing campaigns.
- Event planning and PR experience.
- Previous experience within a B2 B environment.
- Understanding of logistics, supply chain or transport sectors.

What they Offer
- Competitive salary of 30,000 - 36,000.
- Opportunity to join a growing and ambitious business.
- Genuine career progression and development opportunities.
- Collaborative and supportive working environment.
- Opportunity to shape and influence the company's marketing strategy.

Apply Now

If you're a driven, creative and ambitious marketing professional looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Location: Staffordshire
Salary: Flexible DOE
Hours: 37.5 per week
B2 B Marketing Construction Landscaping Built Environment

Are you a B2 B marketer looking for a role where you can genuinely take ownership and have the freedom to shape how a business takes itself to market?

I'm working with a large, established landscaping business with a strong reputation across commercial landscaping, housing developments, grounds maintenance and horticulture.

They're looking for a Marketing Manager to take ownership of their B2 B marketing activity, working closely with the Managing Director and wider senior management team.

The Role

This is a hands-on role with plenty of variety.

You'll get out into the business, visit projects, work with operational teams and understand what clients are looking for - then turn that into marketing activity that raises the company's profile and supports both existing relationships and new business opportunities.

Day to day, you'll be involved in:
- Creating and managing B2 B content across LinkedIn, email and the website
- Visiting live and completed projects to gather content, photography and case studies
- Working with Contracts Managers and operational teams to understand upcoming projects
- Developing presentations, brochures, project sheets and sales collateral
- Supporting tenders, social value content and new business opportunities
- Managing email campaigns and the wider marketing calendar
- Supporting wider horticultural and nursery marketing activity
- Keeping the website and marketing materials up to date
- Working with senior management on marketing strategy and upcoming priorities
- Identifying opportunities to improve reach and strengthen the company's position in the market

There's already plenty happening across the business - they need someone who can find the stories worth telling and make sure they're reaching the right people.

About You

You'll need to be a proactive B2 B marketer who's comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be given a detailed brief.

You don't need to come directly from landscaping. Experience within construction, housebuilding, property, facilities management or another B2 B built-environment environment would be useful, but isn't essential.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous B2 B marketing experience
- Strong written and content creation skills
- Experience managing LinkedIn, websites and email marketing
- Practical graphic design capability, ideally Adobe InDesign and Canva
- The confidence to work directly with senior managers and operational teams
- A commercial mindset and an ability to spot opportunities
- Plenty of drive, creativity and initiative
- Full UK driving licence

We're open on level. You could already be operating as a Marketing Manager, or you may be a strong Senior Marketing Executive looking for the opportunity to step up and take more ownership.

Perks & Benefits
- 33 days' holiday including bank holidays
- Company pension
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Training and development
- Mileage reimbursement/pool vehicle for site visits
- Flexibility around start and finish times
- Some flexibility to work from home once established
- Direct exposure to senior management
- Plenty of autonomy to bring your own ideas to the role
- Genuine scope to develop the position and carve out your own role

This would suit someone who wants more than a narrow marketing role. You'll have the opportunity to get under the skin of the business, understand its clients and projects and have a genuine influence over how it's positioned in the market.

For more information or to apply, please contact Leo at MorePeople.
